title: ID0445784-DC/SI-D/AT-[ RVP / T2 170004421] Metal cover in wrong color & missing cable glands
description:
Reported issue:
The fan cover, base, cable entry for power supply, cable entry for
dispenser, and lock were delivered in white instead of grey. The
cable grommets for the main power supply (9x M40, 2x M20, 1x
M25) were missing.
Solution: NA
yyyy-mm-dd: NA

Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0445784
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-AT SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
RVP/T2170004421
Charger ID / Serial No.:
y2QrMB
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
Order and replace the parts accordingly. If the spare parts are not available in the document, please reach out to
fg_order_management_lpz.infra@siemens.com
or Eric Laemmel
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-XX SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

There is no point in reordering the cable entry, as we have sealed it with PU foam.
Similarly, the cost of the cable grommets would be less than €500, and we would not be able to claim the costs.
Ticket is closed.
